title: Using predictive multiplicity to measure individual performance within the AI Act
reasoning: The entire paper is motivated by and centered on the ethical and legal implications of the EU AI Act. It specifically analyzes 'Trustworthy AI' frameworks, human-centric AI, and the protection of fundamental rights. It argues that 'predictive multiplicity' (the arbitrariness of model selection) is an ethical and regulatory problem and proposes metrics to evaluate individual performance to ensure fairness and reliability in high-stakes human-impacting decisions.
